body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 84 (2026-10-26 10:25Z) compacts revs 79-83 and adds LATE WAKE.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Review results are parent-only (w-fb35d7e76d72): the parent copies the complete findings verbatim to MAIN target/tmp/*-review-findings.md and sends the path.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent. Keep store checks short (no `engram doctor` on a live store). No foreground Bash in the coordinator while an Engram gate or a credited run is in flight (w-350df830dfd0); use MCP tools, Read/Grep/Glob and PowerShell instead.
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus (Advisor #1815/#1816). The limit is per model: Sonnet is still the Claude vendor. Use Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused; record the refusal text. Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.
!! A CLAUDE EXPLORER IS NOT READ-ONLY (P1 w-dc7657cc3529): mode=explorer with writePolicy readOnly auto-approves tools (it ran git add and wrote files). Reviewer and evaluator modes ARE enforced. Spawn read-only Claude delegations in REVIEWER mode. Cursor, Gemini and Kimi explorers are restricted.

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results live in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, chaining or an env prefix is not (w-1d9259ed138e, w-7b952e51f788).
- A --target-dir OUTSIDE the named root is refused credit (w-32d02e1dd7f6); fine for a WARM. Gates use ./target inside the root.
- Credit binds to the turn's focused claim and the root's named binding (w-fec83085cff0). Never rerun only for credit.
- SETTLEMENT LAG (w-667e66aecbff): after reading a terminal result, END the turn; edit the root only in the NEXT turn.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it, no force.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08).
- Claude lanes don't read mail mid-turn: tell lanes to check the mailbox between steps.

WAKES AND MAIL
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): re-send after durableButNotWoken, but first check the status (often mid-turn).
- LATE WAKE (P2 w-4e44aca45353): "deliveredToIdleSession" is set at DISPATCH; it does not prove the model ran the turn. A wake turn stalled in provider-connection retries holds later wakes, so a grant can arrive together with its withdrawal 40-60 min late. Check the recipient's processedThrough. A slot or launch grant unread for about 15 min is withdrawn and re-granted later; an idle build slot may be lent.
- Idempotency keys are unique per SENDER (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path} takes effect next turn. Clear: {work} with no path, from a live claim. 64-slot shared table: own-clear after done; an own-clear 409 "holds no live claim" (w-b964389ee54a) → leave it.
- EVALUATION 409s (P1 w-33f4cde5413c). (a) Token per WORK; after a fresh naming or ANY tracker write, END the turn and stay idle ≥60 s, then evaluate in a separate turn. (b) A final submit 409 "stopped naming the source root ... generation N" while still named: re-name under the same claim, end the turn, then ONE fresh evaluation later with no writes between; if it 409s again, ask TermAl. (c) Owner evaluating its own pre-landing root after landing: name the LANDED root, then ONE fresh evaluator. (d) The evaluator cites ONLY the holder's own notes; the holder writes a guidance note first, then waits out the quiet window.
- SECOND ITEM IN ONE SESSION (w-6cf3141a12c3): switch focus, checkpoint, END idle, then ONE fresh evaluator.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE AND INPUT HYGIENE (w-13b44cf369af): freeze with the WORKTREE as cwd; the input fully STAGED by explicit `git add` (never -A). The coordinator reads every manifest (root, head, untracked) before spawning reviewers.

GATES: from the named root, FOREGROUND `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`. START to Fable2 before launch; respect the interim build-slot rule (coordination-queue); a failed gate discards that round's reviews. Check disk first (alert under 100 GB).

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write that turn. A settled evaluator may not be reusable (w-049ac52c3f72): spawn ONE fresh one. Evaluator Git with compound && is refused by design (w-271157ee5c90). BRIEF BOUND (P3 w-4c12f6badafc): each selected criterionEvidence body is capped at 16 KiB; keep proof notes under about 5 KB and let the evaluator read larger notes by locator; never split a record to fit.
READ-ONLY LEAVES CAN'T RUN ENGRAM READ WORDS (P2 w-dea9f053cd70): put FULL record ids and verbatim fields in proof notes; the leaf discloses it relied on them. Related: w-bbc0, w-37b7, w-9def.
SPAWN HOLD persistenceUnknown (P2 w-a6c410f4f558): a held spawn with cancel as its only action usually recovers within minutes. Don't cancel; re-check after 1-2 min; cancel only after about 5 min and report it.

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab) or a model-capacity error with queuePaused: ask Fable2.

OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (w-540531f46f53 C4). Flaky TermAl probe under load: w-31fe. CLI --help issue: w-02f3bce82afe. After an OS crash, SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0; TermAl w-35bdcb766b6c). Host memory exhaustion crashed TermAl at 06:12Z on 10-26 (w-002b151e7b26).
